 (out/'report.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
 print('FUTURE_TEST_T02_STORAGE_JSON: '+json.dumps({'report':{'file':str((out/'report.json').relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()},'groups':groups,'scenario':scenario},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
